items.title: No Ownership via GPA / Wills
items.description: The Supreme Court held that Power of Attorney (GPA), Agreement to Sell, or Wills do not transfer title. Properties held under these arrangements require regularisation via registered deeds.

items.badgeClass: inline-block px-3 py-1 bg-red-100 text-red-800 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider
items.title: Registration Alone is Not Title
items.description: A landmark judgment stating that mere registration of a document does not prove ownership unless the transferor had a clear legal right to sell and the buyer holds actual possession with payment proof.
